sentences.text: This dinosaur measured about 2.5 meters in length and weighed between 85 and 100 kilograms.
Caenagnathus likely possessed a coat of feathers, as is typical for oviraptorosaurs.
The genus Caenagnathus was named by Sternberg in 1940.
Fossils of Caenagnathus were found in the Dinosaur Park Formation of Alberta, Canada.
A 2020 study of a Chirostenotes specimen with a mandible supports the view that Caenagnathus is a distinct genus from Chirostenotes.
Caenagnathus lived during the Campanian stage of the late Cretaceous, approximately 75 million years ago.
The time range for Caenagnathus spans from the Campanian to the Maastrichtian, between 83.6 and 66 million years ago.
